FN-B017JQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 130
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Sponsor: Senator Vivian Figures
Development
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/18/2023
Senate Bill 130 as introduced moves the holiday observation of Robert E. Lee's birthday from
the third Monday in January to the second Monday in October. In addition, this bill allows
public schools and banks to be open on Veterans Day, and for public schools (K-12) and
community colleges to remain open on Memorial Day. This bill will not directly affect state or
local funding.
